registryTitle: MC-10R amendment registry (PI-01 to PI-05, IV-01 to IV-09)
note: Registry of the fourteen candidate amendments prepared by MC-10R. Every entry is a proposal: no approval evidence exists, no effective date exists and no amendment is in force. PI entries are not approvals; IV entries are candidate instrument versions that remain REVIEW_REQUIRED or DRAFT_NOT_APPROVED. The historical instrument version 1.0.0 and the historical plan remain the only effective readings.
previousVersionPolicy: The historical effective versions (instrument 1.0.0, plan v1.0.0, segment quotas v1.0.0) are preserved and may never be edited in place. A candidate version is effective only after a dated recorded human approval that this milestone cannot confer.

amendments.title: Sampling arithmetic reconciliation: per-segment quotas sum to 37/57 while the total target states 40-80
amendments.source: MC-09 planning inconsistency register (docs/marea/customer-discovery/data/research-status.json, PI-01, severity BLOCKING_BEFORE_FIELDING)
amendments.summary: Preserve the historical per-segment quotas as the authoritative completion requirement (minimum 37, achievable maximum 57); preserve 40-80 as a historical planning aspiration that cannot be met at its upper end under the preserved maxima; adopt the sequential multi-wave reading (Wave 1 pilot 18-28, Wave 2 completes 37 minimum to 57 maximum, Wave 3 only under a separate approved amendment). No quota value is changed and no threshold is lowered.

amendments.title: Single authoritative segment-quota contract replacing the three conflicting minimum/target readings
amendments.source: MC-09 planning inconsistency register (docs/marea/customer-discovery/data/research-status.json, PI-02, severity BLOCKING_BEFORE_FIELDING)
amendments.summary: One versioned machine-readable quota contract carrying all fifteen contract fields per segment, separating minimum, target, ceiling and experiment minimum-evidence readings, so no segment is silently redefined. The preserved numbers are unchanged; the candidate contract is not effective.

amendments.title: Pricing feasibility: registered n>=8 minimum versus preserved segment maxima
amendments.source: MC-09 planning inconsistency register (docs/marea/customer-discovery/data/research-status.json, PI-03, severity BLOCKING_BEFORE_PRICING_ANALYSIS)
amendments.summary: Classify each segment x experiment x construct cell as REACHABLE_AT_PLANNED_MAX or BELOW_REGISTERED_MINIMUM. SEG-01, SEG-02, SEG-03 and SEG-07 reach n>=8 at their planned maxima; SEG-04 (7), SEG-05 (7), SEG-06 (5) and SEG-08 (6) are BELOW_REGISTERED_MINIMUM and may produce qualitative price objections only. The n>=8 minimum is never reduced and no price is approved.

amendments.title: Required instrument amendments IV-01 to IV-06 before any fielding
amendments.source: MC-09 planning inconsistency register (docs/marea/customer-discovery/data/research-status.json, PI-04, severity BLOCKING_BEFORE_FIELDING)
amendments.summary: Six dated instrument amendments are required before any fielding: quotation and de-identification consent wording (CONSENT-01), brand-disclosure text and timing (GUIDE-01), PRICE-01 ladder-provenance freeze, consent version and language capture (NOTE-01, SCHEMA-01), ANA-01 operational codebook v1.1.0, and supervisory-authority complaint information that depends on the undesignated controller. All remain unapproved.

amendments.title: Owner-side instrument gaps IV-07 to IV-09 before Wave 1 and Wave 3
amendments.source: MC-09 planning inconsistency register (docs/marea/customer-discovery/data/research-status.json, PI-05, severity BLOCKING_BEFORE_WAVE_1_AND_WAVE_3)
amendments.summary: Three owner-side instrument amendments close the gaps recorded as IV-07 to IV-09: a neutral incident and near-miss sequence for EXP-MC10-09, exclusions-before-benefits ordering in GUIDE-01 Q11, and reconciliation of the GUIDE-01 concept set A-E with the programme concept ids NAV, WATCH, PROTECT, HUB, START, INTEGRATED_SYSTEM and FLEET. Historical v1.0.0 scripts are preserved and never silently recoded.

amendments.title: Quotation and de-identification consent
amendments.summary: CONSENT-01 v1.1.0 adds explicit quotation permission and de-identification rules so that C3 (de-identified quotation) is a recorded scope, not an inference from participation consent. Candidate section hash is non-effective; no qualified review is claimed.

amendments.title: Brand-disclosure text and timing
amendments.summary: Frozen brand-disclosure wording and its position in the session are added to GUIDE-01 v1.1.0 so the disclosure is identical across interviewers and its effect is a registered confounder rather than an improvisation. Candidate text is not approved and no translation equivalence is claimed.

amendments.title: PRICE-01 ladder provenance record
amendments.summary: PRICE-01 v1.1.0 records ladder provenance (derivation note, rationale, hash) for every administered point, so a price answer can never be detached from the frozen ladder version that produced it. EXP-MC10-03 is a qualitative experiment whose threshold is not changed.

amendments.title: Consent version and language capture in NOTE-01 and SCHEMA-01
amendments.summary: NOTE-01 and SCHEMA-01 v1.1.0 capture the exact consent instrument version and language that the participant saw, so record validity can be verified instead of assumed. No threshold, denominator or verdict rule is changed.

amendments.title: ANA-01 operational codebook v1.1.0
amendments.summary: ANA-01 v1.1.0 reconciles the twelve operational codes with the eight theme families so double coding can be consistent across coders. No code is exercised: zero coded units exist.

amendments.title: Supervisory-authority complaint information
amendments.summary: CONSENT-01 privacy text gains a complaint route to the supervisory authority, but the wording cannot be finalized while the data controller and privacy contact remain OPEN; recorded as DRAFT_FOR_LEGAL_REVIEW and never as approved.

amendments.title: Incident and near-miss sequence for EXP-MC10-09
amendments.summary: GUIDE-01 v1.1.0 adds a neutral incident and near-miss discovery sequence so EXP-MC10-09 can obtain its registered evidence type without improvisation. The registered threshold and minimum evidence are unchanged.

amendments.title: Exclusions before benefits in GUIDE-01 Q11
amendments.summary: GUIDE-01 Q11 is reordered so exclusions are probed before benefits, matching the programme rule and avoiding a leading sequence. EXP-MC10-06 is primary; EXP-MC10-10 and EXP-MC10-01 are not changed in threshold or method.

amendments.title: Concept-ID reconciliation (GUIDE-01 A-E to programme concept ids)
amendments.summary: Maps GUIDE-01 concept set A-E to the machine concept ids NAV, WATCH, PROTECT, HUB, START, INTEGRATED_SYSTEM and FLEET so comprehension, coding and price modules reference one identity. Historical v1.0.0 scripts are preserved as historical records and are never silently recoded. No threshold is changed.
